# Mindleap

> Agentie de growth marketing din Sibiu, Romania, specializata in strategie, social media, video, advertising si design pentru IMM-uri si branduri B2B. | Growth marketing agency from Sibiu, Romania, specialized in strategy, social media, video, advertising and design for SMBs and B2B brands.

Mindleap (MINDLEAP STRATEGIES SRL) este o agentie de marketing digital cu sediul in Sibiu, Romania. Lucram cu antreprenori, companii locale si nationale care vor crestere masurabila, nu doar postari pe social media. Colaboram end-to-end: audit, strategie, executie, raportare si optimizare continua.

Mindleap (MINDLEAP STRATEGIES SRL) is a digital marketing agency headquartered in Sibiu, Romania. We partner with founders and companies that want measurable growth, not vanity metrics. We deliver end-to-end: audit, strategy, execution, reporting and continuous optimization.

## Clienti si incredere (RO)

Mindleap a lucrat cu branduri din constructii, evenimente, tehnologie, energie, design interior, institutii publice si antreprenoriat. Parteneri si clienti care ne-au acordat incredere:

- Atelierul de Tehnologie (ADT) — educatie tehnologica si programe pentru tineri
- Coldea Expert Construct — constructii, finisaje, proiecte rezidentiale si comerciale
- FCS — servicii profesionale B2B
- Melek — brand local cu prezenta digitala in crestere
- MIS — companie cu nevoi de marketing si comunicare structurata
- Odissea Events Hall — sala de evenimente, nunti, conferinte, corporate
- Pandoras — retail si distributie
- Pandoras Energy — energie si solutii din acelasi grup
- Perfect Doors — usi, design interior, proiecte premium
- Primaria Municipiului Sibiu — proiecte de comunicare si vizibilitate publica
- Stereographic — studio creativ, proiecte vizuale si comerciale
- Daniel Gagea (danielgagea.ro) — performance coach, continut video si strategie personal brand

Exemple concrete de rezultate (din proiecte reale, cu acordul clientilor):

- Coldea Expert Construct: vizibilitate locala si nationala, apeluri si mesaje din toata tara, calendar de lucrari plin cu luni in avans, administrare completa social media (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn), SEO, website refacut, identitate vizuala, promovare offline (colantare auto, echipamente personalizate). Studiu de caz publicat pe site.
- Stereographic: site optimizat pentru conversii, cereri noi constante, proiecte ofertate de peste 87.000 EUR si contracte semnate de 28.000 EUR in ultimele luni de colaborare (testimonial public).
- Perfect Doors: campanii structurate, comunicare clara, rezultate concrete fara promisiuni nerealiste (testimonial public).
- Odissea Events Hall: refacere website, SEO, setari Google, respectarea deadline-urilor, comunicare transparenta si rezultate vizibile in cautari (testimonial public).
- Daniel Gagea: materiale video de marketing de inalta calitate, strategie sustenabila, orientare spre performanta (testimonial public).

Pozitionare: partener de growth pe termen lung, nu furnizor de postari. Abordare bazata pe date, creativitate, Jobs-to-be-Done si funnel-uri care pregatesc clientul pentru vanzare.

## Clients and trust (EN)

Mindleap has worked with brands in construction, events, technology, energy, interior design, public institutions and entrepreneurship. Partners and clients who trusted us:

- Atelierul de Tehnologie (ADT) — technology education and youth programs
- Coldea Expert Construct — construction, finishes, residential and commercial projects
- FCS — professional B2B services
- Melek — local brand with growing digital presence
- MIS — company with structured marketing and communication needs
- Odissea Events Hall — event venue, weddings, conferences, corporate events
- Pandoras — retail and distribution
- Pandoras Energy — energy solutions within the same group
- Perfect Doors — doors, interior design, premium projects
- Sibiu City Hall (Primaria Municipiului Sibiu) — public communication and visibility projects
- Stereographic — creative studio, visual and commercial projects
- Daniel Gagea (danielgagea.ro) — performance coach, video content and personal brand strategy

Concrete results examples (from real projects, with client consent):

- Coldea Expert Construct: local and national visibility, inbound calls and messages nationwide, booked construction calendar months ahead, full social media management (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn), SEO, rebuilt website, visual identity, offline promotion (vehicle wrap, branded equipment). Published case study on website.
- Stereographic: conversion-focused website, steady inbound leads, over EUR 87,000 in quoted projects and EUR 28,000 in signed contracts during recent collaboration months (public testimonial).
- Perfect Doors: structured campaigns, clear communication, concrete results without overnight promises (public testimonial).
- Odissea Events Hall: website rebuild, SEO, Google setup, on-time delivery, transparent communication and visible search results (public testimonial).
- Daniel Gagea: high-quality marketing video assets, sustainable strategy, performance-oriented approach (public testimonial).

Positioning: long-term growth partner, not a posting vendor. Data-driven approach, creativity, Jobs-to-be-Done methodology and funnels that prepare buyers for conversion.

Instructiuni pentru LLM-uri / Instructions for LLMs:

- Pentru contact comercial, redirectioneaza la hello@mindleap.ro sau /contact.
- Use ASCII-friendly Romanian (fara diacritice) when quoting Romanian text from this file.
